transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Ever since I was in a car accident two weeks ago, I just can’t think straight or focus long enough to finish anything, even simple tasks at work. It's gotten to the point where I'm really falling behind, and my manager is starting to notice.
Since the accident, have you been experiencing recurring, intrusive thoughts or nightmares about the crash, or are you primarily struggling with emotional and behavioral changes?

I’m actually struggling with both. These vivid pictures of the crash—the sound of the impact, the shattered glass, and the smell of burning rubber—constantly pop into my head and make my heart race. At the same time, I've become so jumpy around loud noises and find myself snapping at my sister and coworkers because I'm just so irritable and unable to focus.
Since the accident occurred two weeks ago, have these intrusive thoughts and symptoms been present for more than three days, or have they lasted longer than a full month?

They started right after the crash two weeks ago and have been happening constantly every single day since then. So it's been about two weeks now, which is definitely more than three days but not quite a full month yet.
